decisions.reason: As a newly launched sensor module close to the core modular platform, it is relatively cheap to keep available while the firm learns demand, so the option value of waiting exceeds the near-term case for withdrawal.

This industrial input module extends the established automation range and was given a dedicated product page, suggesting enough strategic commitment and low enough incremental platform cost to keep it on the market while adoption becomes clearer.

A solid state relay module fits directly with the firm's control and automation architecture, so in a growing firm with broad offerings it is worth retaining as a low-cost adjacent option rather than abandoning early.

The server room monitoring kit is somewhat more application-specific than the other launches, so its drop risk is higher, but as a recent product built from existing modules it still makes sense to keep it another year to resolve demand uncertainty.
